dedupe_keys.name: iwmi solar irrigation pump sizing tool india excel tool for crop water need discharge head loss and pump selection

description: The Solar Irrigation Pump Sizing Tool from the International Water Management Institute (IWMI) helps farmers, researchers and technical staff promoting solar pumping in India to size a solar irrigation pump for a given location. It draws on nationwide datasets of climate, soils and crops and has four modules: crop water requirement, discharge estimation, head loss estimation and pump selection, and it recommends pump models and features for different scenarios from the user's inputs. It is built in Microsoft Excel so that it can be used where connectivity is poor, and comes with a user manual that describes the data variables and models. Coverage: India. Format and access: Excel workbook and manual in the CGIAR repository (hdl.handle.net/10568/121051); free, open access; published 21 November 2022 with support from GIZ, BMZ and ICAR. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): IWMI terms of use: reuse with attribution for non-commercial, research or educational purposes, share-alike. Caveats: the workbook and manual were not opened, so the pump catalogue and equations were not checked. Simulation uses: sizing and capacity planning of solar pumping for irrigation, including the load such pumps place on rural energy and groundwater. Related records: IWMI's power plant freshwater demand dataset (data-iwmi-africa-power-plant-freshwater-demand-2020) covers another part of the water-energy link.
